name: T12-airplane
description: Airplane mode from before launch, so the startup upload stalls and can never complete. Precondition for the pre-bump 'wedged flusher' behaviour.

steps.why: settle and let one foreground disk flush land (~5s, stats.first_upload_flush_interval_ms) so the FG/BG split has a positive control. This used to be 35s to clear the 30s stats.minimum_upload_interval_ms floor, but that floor is armed ONLY by a flush-path upload (stats.rs: last_flush_upload_time), and shared-core 184c3229 removed the workflow trigger that used to fire one at launch. A fresh process now reaches ON_STOP unarmed, so the long wait gated nothing. Verified: ON_STOP upload allowed 1.88s after a periodic upload.
covers the ~5s background network cutoff plus at least one ~30s timed flush
